name: Yarippanashi
source:
Heroine, that mother and further?

Main character has a hobby to train women, but while using others to achieve that. The ultimate aim is to reach fiancee and mother. The cycle of endless subjugation begins.

[Edited from [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-december-2003-saya-no-uta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
女主角、她的母亲，还有更多人？

主人公嗜好调教女性，并会利用他人来达成目的。
最终目标是未婚妻与母亲。
永无止境的支配循环就此开始。

[改编自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-december-2003-saya-no-uta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
